sentences.text: Shri Ajay Kumar Jain - Advocate for the appellant.

Shri Satyapal Chadar - Government A
 respondent/State.
Heard on I.A. No.16345 of 2024, repeat (second) application under Section 389(1) of the Cr.P.C. for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to appellant Saurav Kahar.

The appellant has been convicted under Section 363 of IPC and sentenced to undergo RI for 7 years and fine of Rs.1,000/-, Section 366 of IPC and sentenced to undergo RI for 10 years and fine of Rs.
1,000/-, Section 51 read with Section 6 of IPC and Section 376(2)(n) of the IPC and sentenced to undergo RI for 20 years and fine of Rs.1,000/- and Section 376(3) of the IPC and sentenced to undergo RI for 20 years and fine of Rs. 1,000/- with default stipulation.
His first application was dismissed as withdrawn by order dated 04.07.2023 (I.A.No.1092 of 2023).

Learned counsel for the appellant submits that earlier bail application of appellant was dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to renew it after one year and present application has been filed after completion of one year.
Parents of prosecutrix have turned hostile and they have not supported prosecution story.
From deposition of prosecutrix also, it appears that she is a 2 CRA-927-2023 consenting party.
It is also urged that parties have compromised the matter before trial Court.
Appellant is in jail since 26.05.2021 and during trial also, appellant was in custody.
Early hearing of this appeal is not possible in near future.
On above grounds, it is urged that remaining jail sentence of appellant be suspended and he be released on bail.
Learned Government Advocate for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has opposed the application.
We have gone through the material available on record and having regard to the same, we deem it proper to suspend remaining jail sentence of appellant.

sentences.text: Accordingly, I.A.No.16345 of 2024 is allowed.

Subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited, the remaining jail sentence of appellant is hereby suspended and it is directed that appellant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court with a further direction to appear before concerning trial Court on 12.11.2024 and also on such other dates, as may be fixed by the trial court in this regard during the pendency of this appeal.
List the matter for final hearing in due course.
Certified copy as per rules.
